Centrelink & Medicare Services Guide

10 step-by-step service guides

Detailed guides for every major Centrelink payment and Medicare service in Australia. Each guide covers eligibility, payment amounts, how to apply (online via myGov or in person at a Service Centre), and common questions. Combined with our directory of 318 Service Centres, these guides help you find both the service and the centre you need.
